## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Sree Gnanambika Catering Services?
No. 5A, Sivakami Nagar, 1st Main Road, Hasthinapuram, Chromepet, Chennai 600 064.

### What facilities does Sree Gnanambika Catering Services have?
Wedding catering, Reception buffets, Housewarming / grihapravesam, Birthday catering, Corporate catering, Outdoor catering, Iyer & Iyengar menus, Kerala menu, Seemantham & engagement menus, Banana-leaf service, Vegetable & ice carving, Designer thamboolam bags.

### Is the catering pure vegetarian?
Yes. Sree Gnanambika is a 100% pure vegetarian caterer, with traditional Iyer and Iyengar menus.

### What events do you cater?
Weddings, receptions, housewarmings, birthdays, corporate events and outdoor functions.
